summary: # Marvelous Designer Official: 2023 User Communication Conference - Xu Guodong ## Introduction First of all, let me introduce the process of our project. In this presentation, I will cover three main areas: 1. An overview of our project. 2. A discussion of my personal projects and experiences. 3. Insights into my personal experiences in clothing design. ## Project Overview Let me show you some examples that I have applied in the project. These examples reflect my personal experiences in clothing design. ### Model Development The first one is a high-end model that I have used for the first time. Currently, the model shows significant improvement, incorporating personal experiences in clothing design, resulting in a good return effect. We have numerous models that we plan to use in the future. Some of these models are made of metal and are built by machines. ### Use of Marvelous Designer In addition, we use Marvelous Designer (MD) to create some V-boxes, which work great. For example, in the Tokyo-M Pennsylvania Airmen's Special Airbase project, we designed genderless outfits and accessories. These designs are also well-suited for MD to create short sleeves and various clothing styles. ## Personal Projects and Experiences Moving on to some of my personal projects, I also developed custom-made pieces, including more extreme and advanced designs that utilize a variety of materials. ### Game Interfaces This includes designs for mobile games, which are developed from direct screenshots and other video games. Additionally, I have created more extreme pieces intended for posters and animations. ## Technical Processes Now, let's discuss the technical processes involved in our projects. ### UV-Transfer Process One of the key processes we use is called UV-transfer, which connects quality construction with MD. The current challenge we face is that, with the latest generation of MD software, it presents a flat structure. To address this, we sometimes need to change the designs to align with the body of the project. #### Assembly Challenges The most difficult part is the assembly process. Aligning the assembly with the clothing's structure is where many difficulties arise. We utilize tools to facilitate this process. ### Designing with Hardware For hardware, we can connect any keyboard directly. For instance, we can use GB, Mac, and others. We design the UV lines on the assembly part, which is essential for our workflow. #### Quality Control Once designed, we can ensure that the quality of the MD software is maintained at 100%. This allows for adjustments, such as left-right copying and alignment, ensuring all curves are accurate and functional. ## Advanced Techniques We often utilize specific techniques to enhance our designs. ### Curve Adjustments For instance, we adjust curves to ensure they reflect the desired design aspects, taking into account the natural flow of the garment. ### Efficiency in Design By employing a keyboard system, our team can process designs quickly, ensuring that all clothing fits perfectly without the need for extensive body measurements. ## Interaction with MD Software The MD system allows for efficient interaction with clothing design. By locking specific parameters and using consistent measurements, we streamline our workflow and reduce the potential for errors. ### Data Management Collecting and managing data effectively is crucial. This ensures that any modifications remain consistent and that the integrity of the design process is maintained. ## Future Considerations As we move forward, we aim to refine our processes further, making them faster and more efficient. The goal is to present designs that are not only functional but also aesthetically pleasing. ### Artistic Considerations In the realm of design, we often explore the balance between artistic expression and practical functionality. Understanding the nuances of beauty in design helps in creating garments that resonate with users. ## Q&A Session At this point, I would like to open the floor for questions. I appreciate your engagement and look forward to discussing any thoughts you may have regarding the processes and techniques shared today. Thank you!
